name: Jolyon (Joe) Gentile
headline: From Chaos to Clarity - Smarter ERP, Better Business - Managing Director at Aptus Business Solutions Pty Ltd
post_snippet: Even as the Managing Director, I continue to be amazed by the thoughtfulness, creativity, and care that goes into the culture we've built together. This year, every father at Aptus received a beautifully curated gift box...
comment_draft: Culture is hard to build through policy but easy to see through gestures. A gift box for dads lands differently than a bonus; it says the company remembers who people are outside work. That kind of consistency is what makes people stay.

name: Yurii Kuzminov
headline: CEO & Founder at Axceleris | eCommerce expert - Shopify Plus, Magento, Adobe Commerce | 16+ years of helping digital businesses grow
post_snippet: Shoptalk Europe, Barcelona, let's do this! I'll be happy to chat about eCommerce growth, Magento/Adobe Commerce/Shopify, CRO and UX improvements, SEO/GEO/AEO, technical bottlenecks, revenue opportunities. Free eCommerce audits for selected brands.
comment_draft: Senior-level audits beat automated reports because the value is in knowing which bottlenecks compound versus which are cosmetic. Running them live at a conference surfaces context a formal report usually misses.

name: Raghu Gnanasekaran
headline: Ex-Vice President Global SaaS Partnerships NetSuite
post_snippet: Anthropic just revealed 80% of their code is written by Claude. What that means for who owns your enterprise intelligence.
comment_draft: When AI writes the code, ownership shifts from 'who licensed it' to 'who can reason about what it encodes.' ERP durability has always rested on auditability and override. Worth examining when the generation layer is opaque.

name: Emily Peterson
headline: Vice President, Ecommerce & Growth at Over The Moon
post_snippet: Come join my team! I am so excited to be hiring for this crucial role - a senior manager to lead our integrated marketing efforts whose superpower is connecting the dots across cross-functional teams to drive impactful, full-funnel storytelling.
comment_draft: Full-funnel storytellers who can actually map the narrative from social to post-purchase are rare because most teams optimize channels separately. The connective tissue is usually where both the inefficiency and the biggest leverage sit.

name: Adam Tregear
headline: Flux, Fractionus & Briick
post_snippet: Businesses aren't just hiring a person anymore. They're hiring a human and their AI stack. Your value is no longer just your experience, your network, or your advice. It's your judgment, multiplied by the systems you bring with you.
comment_draft: The test is whether the stack amplifies judgment or substitutes it. Most practitioners use AI as a search accelerant. The ones worth hiring have wired it into how they actually think through problems, not just what they produce.
